required_outcomes: Recognises that nothing is due yet: the next reading is needed in mid-June 2025 and today is 31 December 2024.
Keeps the request on hold, or sets a dated follow-up, through a verified action with an explicit review date ahead of mid-June 2025 (late May to early June), so the reading is requested in time.
Sends the tenant no request for a reading now.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord to confirm the next due date, because the request says every 3 months yet names mid-June, provided a dated hold or follow-up is still recorded.
An earlier review date than May, provided it is explicit and the tenant is not asked for the reading yet.
positive_behaviours: Notes the inconsistency between 'every 3 months' and 'Next due Mid June' in the request.
Replaces the repeated fortnightly 'waiting for june' holds with a single hold dated to when the work is due.
red_flags: Asks the tenant for a solar reading photo now, months before it is needed.
Escalates to a human over a task that is simply not due yet.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a maintenance provider or raising any cost.
Closing the request before the June reading has been collected.
critical_failures: The request is closed or left with no review date, so nothing triggers the June reading.
